pageIntro: Connect {appName} to the tools you already use. Pick an integration, download its config, and your files land here.
advancedDesc: Manage individual tokens, or generate configs for other devices and scripts.

oneClick.title: One click and you're set up
oneClick.desc: We'll create your token and a ready-to-import ShareX config. No copying, no pasting - just double-click the file and start capturing.
oneClick.downloadSuccess: ShareX config downloaded - just double-click it
oneClick.downloadError: Couldn't generate your ShareX config. Try again.
oneClick.domainNote: Your config posts to <host>this address</host>. Changed your link domain in <link>your profile</link>? Download a fresh config - ShareX keeps the address inside the file.

manager.title: API tokens
manager.desc: Tokens authenticate uploads from ShareX, scripts, and the API. Treat them like passwords.
manager.emptyDesc: Create your first token to download a ready-to-import ShareX config and start capturing.
manager.narrowError: Couldn't narrow this token. It may already be narrower, or revoked.

dialog.createDesc: Give it a recognizable name - e.g. the device or app it's for.
dialog.createdDesc: Set up ShareX in seconds, or grab the raw token for scripts.
dialog.warning: Copy this token now - for your security it won't be shown again. Anyone with it can act as you, within its scope.
dialog.scopeHint: Pick the narrowest option that works. You can narrow a token later, but never widen one.
dialog.narrowDesc: Take capabilities away from a token that is already in use. Clients keep working for whatever is left.
dialog.narrowWarning: This cannot be undone. Widening a token would promote a leaked one, so growing its reach means creating a new token instead.

guide.step1Body: Hit “Create token” above and give it a name you'll recognize.
guide.step2Body: Grab the .sxcu file from the success dialog - it's pre-filled for you.
guide.step3Body: Double-click the .sxcu file. ShareX imports it and sets it as your uploader.
guide.step4Body: Capture as usual - your link is copied to the clipboard automatically.
guide.setupTitle: Set up in under a minute
guide.setupDesc: Four steps to turn {appName} into your screenshot host.
guide.noShareX: No ShareX? You can drag & drop files straight into the <link>web uploader</link> - no token required, just your signed-in session.

sharex.title: ShareX
sharex.desc: The screenshot tool for Windows. One click writes a config with its own token, and every capture uploads straight here.

appCard.desc: Screenshots, screen recording, downloads from YouTube and TikTok, and your whole library in one window. Install it, sign in, and everything you capture lands here.

install.title: Install
install.desc: One installer. No configuration file to import.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.desc: Opens this panel in your browser and comes back. Two-factor works.

use.title: Use it
use.desc: Capture or download, and the link is on your clipboard.

upload.label: Upload only
upload.desc: Can send files in. Cannot list, change or delete anything. This is what ShareX needs.

read.label: Read only
read.desc: Can see files, folders and links, including unlisted ones. Cannot upload or change anything.

write.label: Read and write
write.desc: Can upload, and can rename, move, publish and delete files. This is what the desktop app needs.

full.label: Full access
full.desc: Everything above, plus administrator endpoints. Only create one if you know you need it.
